Docket 1.3.130

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Large sites can be audited whole.* Choosing “Everything” now allows an audit to run for up to a day
  instead of stopping at 15 minutes, and one step that compared every page with every other page now
  compares only pages that could be competing for the same search. A 25,000-page test site that would
  have taken hours is audited in about five minutes, with the same findings. How long a real site takes
  depends on how quickly it answers and how long its robots.txt asks crawlers to wait.
- *Finish now.* A running audit can be finished early: Docket stops crawling and writes the full report
  on the pages it has read. Stop still discards the run.
- *A wrong statement about Google is corrected.* When an audit ran out of time on a site whose robots.txt
  asks for a delay between requests, the report said every crawler reads such a site slowly, Google
  included. Google does not support that rule at all; the report now says so.

99 checks across 13 areas.
